notes.title: Update Actives #2
notes.content:
Here is a new update

New stuff
New item type "Active items"
New item type "Super arts"
10 New items
16 New achievements
Hold variations on charge attacks
Super arts

Active items are an item that can be equipped and leveled up independently of the character up to level 99, the level of the items carries between loops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572090/5710a7d6b3c23431efcdede88d8517ca4f9d2b9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572090/c5276213a266a74b687d171ba6c40e9d241d6eff.gif[/img]
LV.99 Axe in use

Charge attacks now have hold variations, by which i mean if you do a charge attack and hold the attack button while doing them you get a different move
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572090/56af37e985d525646a7ec7d97075a5a8d5ff7a48.gif[/img]

Super arts are an extra move you can equip on your character and are very powerful
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572090/b80686065d769fdadffdfb258117961f11ab8fbd.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
-New stuff
Coins! : coins are like lite diamonds, they give a bit of multiplier and a tiny bit of money trees have a chance of spawning them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572090/3379dc4baee1fb232fad13be8cc62e57cd124489.gif[/img]


A new item Lucky banks : these little guys increase the chance of coins spawning

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572090/0782975d156db2e02d3c2295a99589ceda80b491.png[/img]

8 New achievements

-Fixes
Corrected a couple of translation errors

-Misc
Steam cloud integration
A small icon now highlights a new item is buyable

Hope you have a good time.
